name: Alternate Assist Mod
description: Threshold-triggered Ship cadence assist. Native inputs pass through until manual CPS reaches a configurable threshold, then a fixed-CPS pulse controller takes over and adaptively balances press duty to stabilize vertical velocity.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Ship Assist
assist-enabled.description: Below the Manual Trigger CPS threshold, Ship inputs pass through normally. Once your manual click rate reaches the threshold for two consecutive intervals, the mod switches to an independent fixed-cadence controller.

trigger-cps.name: Manual Trigger CPS
trigger-cps.description: Manual press frequency required to activate cadence assist. Default 5 CPS. Two consecutive press intervals must meet or exceed this threshold.

assist-cps.name: Assist CPS
assist-cps.description: Fixed automatic full press/release cycles per second after activation. Default 16 CPS. Your manual click timing does not change this cadence. Practical maximum is 30 CPS.

straightness.name: Straightness / Feedback Strength
straightness.description: Controls how strongly vertical velocity feedback adjusts the press portion of each fixed-CPS cycle. Higher values make duty-cycle corrections more aggressive.

base-duty.name: Base Pulse Duty (%)
base-duty.description: Neutral percentage of each automatic cycle spent pressing. Feedback adjusts around this base. Start at 50%; tune only if the Ship consistently drifts up or down.

target-vertical-velocity.name: Target Vertical Velocity
target-vertical-velocity.description: Desired gravity-relative vertical velocity. 0 aims for horizontal flight.

manual-activity-window.name: Assist Hold After Last Click (s)
manual-activity-window.description: How long cadence assist remains armed after the last manual press/release. A held key also keeps it active until released.

route-player2-jump-to-player1.name: Route Up Arrow / Player 2 Jump to Player 1 in Single-Player
route-player2-jump-to-player1.description: In non-dual levels, routes P2 jump input to P1 so Up Arrow can control Player 1 when the keybind is mapped to Jump P2. Dual mode preserves P2.

player2-enabled.name: Enable Player 2 Assist
player2-enabled.description: Enables threshold-triggered cadence assist for Player 2 in dual mode.

debug-telemetry.name: Debug Controller Telemetry
debug-telemetry.description: Logs manual CPS, trigger threshold, fixed assist CPS, phase, duty cycle, vertical velocity, physics hook calls and manual input events.
